gcode_macro CHECK_FILAMENT.description: Report the configured runout switch state
gcode_macro CHECK_FILAMENT.gcode:
{% set filament_status = printer['filament_switch_sensor m4_left_runout'].filament_detected %}
M117 Filament {filament_status}

gcode_macro CYCLE_CHAMBER_LIGHTS.description: Cycle chamber/rear panel lights: on -> idle -> off

gcode_macro EXTRUDE_VOLUMETRIC.description: Extrude specified volume of filament using a given diameter

gcode_macro G32.gcode:
SAVE_GCODE_STATE NAME=STATE_G32
STATUS_LEVELING
QUAD_GANTRY_LEVEL
G0 X175 Y175 Z30 F3600
RESTORE_GCODE_STATE NAME=STATE_G32

gcode_macro OPENAMS_LOAD.description: Load a selected OpenAMS slot through the complete safe toolchange sequence

gcode_macro OPENAMS_UNLOAD.description: Unload OpenAMS through the complete cutter and extruder sequence

gcode_macro PAUSE.gcode:
M117 Paused
STATUS_PART_READY
PAUSE_BASE
_TOOLHEAD_PARK_PAUSE_CANCEL {rawparams}
SET_IDLE_TIMEOUT TIMEOUT=86400

gcode_macro PRIME_NOZZLE.gcode:
STATUS_CLEANING
SAVE_GCODE_STATE NAME=PRIME_NOZZLE_STATE
M117 Priming
G90
M83
G92 E0
G1 Z10 F900
G1 Y3 X3 F18000
G1 Z0.2 F900
G91
G1 X100 E25 F1000
G1 Y-2 F1000
G1 X-60 E9 F1000
G1 E-0.5 F3000
G1 X0.5 E0 F1000
G1 X-5.5 E0 F1000
RESTORE_GCODE_STATE NAME=PRIME_NOZZLE_STATE

gcode_macro PRINT_END.gcode:
{% set th = printer.toolhead %}
{% set x_safe = th.position.x + 20 * (1 if th.axis_maximum.x - th.position.x > 20 else -1) %}
{% set y_safe = th.position.y + 20 * (1 if th.axis_maximum.y - th.position.y > 20 else -1) %}
{% set z_safe = [th.position.z + 2, th.axis_maximum.z]|min %}

SAVE_GCODE_STATE NAME=STATE_PRINT_END
SET_LED_EFFECT EFFECT=panel_idle REPLACE=1

M400
G92 E0
G1 E-5.0 F1800

SET_HEATER_TEMPERATURE HEATER="the_filter" TARGET=0
SET_HEATER_TEMPERATURE HEATER=extruder

G90
G0 X{x_safe} Y{y_safe} Z{z_safe} F20000
G0 X{th.axis_maximum.x // 2} Y{th.axis_maximum.y - 2} F3600
M107

BED_MESH_CLEAR
RESTORE_GCODE_STATE NAME=STATE_PRINT_END
turn_chamber_lights_off
STATUS_READY
M117 Ready

gcode_macro PURGE_COLOR.gcode:
G0 X185 Y275 F6000
G0 X185 Y350
G0 Z30 F900
M83
G1 E200 F300
CLEAN_NOZZLE

gcode_macro PURGE_HOTEND.gcode:
STATUS_CLEANING
SAVE_GCODE_STATE NAME=PURGE_HOTEND_STATE
M117 Purging
G90
M83
G92 E0
G1 Z30 F900
G1 X170 Y350 F18000
G1 E300 F300
M117 Ready
RESTORE_GCODE_STATE NAME=PURGE_HOTEND_STATE

gcode_macro UNSAFE_LIFT_TOOLHEAD.gcode:
G90
SET_KINEMATIC_POSITION Z=0
G0 Z10 F600
M84

gcode_macro _TOOLHEAD_PARK_PAUSE_CANCEL.description: Helper: park toolhead used in PAUSE and CANCEL_PRINT

led_effect critical_error.layers:
strobe    1 1.5 add        (1.0,  1.0, 1.0)
breathing 2 0   difference (0.95, 0.0, 0.0)
static    1 0   top        (1.0,  0.0, 0.0)

menu __main __temp __preheat_abs __all.gcode:

M104 S245
SET_HEATER_TEMPERATURE HEATER=the_filter TARGET=60
